crossrefs.text: And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.

So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
Let the wicked man forsake his own way and the unrighteous man his own thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and act, and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart—for You alone know the hearts of all men—
so that they may fear You all the days they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.
Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
